description: Lisa Demuth’s Affordability Agenda for Minnesota As Minnesota House Speaker, Lisa Demuth has fought to reduce the cost of everyday living for residents of all ages and stages of life. As Lisa travels the state, Minnesotans are all saying the same things – stop the fraud, get our money back and make Minnesota affordable. We’re hearing from seniors who struggle…
